entries.name: 2100 General
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 21 Air Conditioning & Pressurisation System > Maintenance Activity > 2100 General
entries.definition: Safety report related to those units and components which furnish a means of pressurizing, heating, cooling, moisture controlling, filtering and treating the air used to ventilate the areas of the fuselage within the pressure seals. Includes cabin supercharger, equipment cooling, heater, heater fuel system, expansion turbine, valves, scoops, ducts, etc.

entries.name: 2110 Cabin compressor system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 21 Air Conditioning & Pressurisation System > Maintenance Activity > 2110 Cabin compressor system
entries.definition: Safety report related to cabin compressor system and its controls which supplies compressed air. Includes items such as controls and indicating systems related to the compressors, wiring, etc. Does not include the pressure control and indicating system for the cabin pressurization.

entries.name: 2120 Air distribution system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 21 Air Conditioning & Pressurisation System > Maintenance Activity > 2120 Air distribution system
entries.definition: Safety report related to air distribution system, used to induct and distribute air. Includes equipment rack cooling systems and items such as blowers, scoops, ducting, inlets, check valves, wiring, etc. Does not include valves which are part of pressurization and temperature control.

entries.name: 2130 Cabin pressure control system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 21 Air Conditioning & Pressurisation System > Maintenance Activity > 2130 Cabin pressure control system
entries.definition: Safety report related tocabin pressure control system, used to control the pressure within the fuselage. Includes items such as control valves, relief valves, indicators, switches, amplifiers, wiring, etc.

entries.name: 2140 Heating system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 21 Air Conditioning & Pressurisation System > Maintenance Activity > 2140 Heating system

entries.name: 2150 Air cooling system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 21 Air Conditioning & Pressurisation System > Maintenance Activity > 2150 Air cooling system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the air cooling system and its controls which supply cooled air. Includes items such as the cooling unit, indicating systems related to the cooler operation, wiring, etc. Does not include temperature control and indicating systems.

entries.name: 2160 Temperature control system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 21 Air Conditioning & Pressurisation System > Maintenance Activity > 2160 Temperature control system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the temparature control system used to control the temperature of the air. Includes items such as control valves, thermal sensing devices, switches, indicators, amplifiers, wiring, etc.

entries.name: 2170 Humidity control system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 21 Air Conditioning & Pressurisation System > Maintenance Activity > 2170 Humidity control system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the humidity control system used to control moisture in the air, to control ozone concentrations, to filter radioactive debris from conditioned air, and to treat the air with deodorizers, insecticides, etc.

entries.definition: Safety report related to the doors i.e. removable units used for entrance or exit, and for enclosing other structure contained within the fuselage. Includes passenger and crew doors, cargo doors, emergency exits, etc. Electrical and hydraulic systems associated with door control are included as appropriate.

entries.name: 5210 Passenger/Crew doors
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 52 Doors > Maintenance Activity > 5210 Passenger/Crew doors
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Passenger/crew doors used for entrance and exit of the passengers and crew to and from the aircraft. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, locking units, handles, insulation, lining, controls, integral steps, ramps, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.

entries.name: 5220 Emergency exits
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 52 Doors > Maintenance Activity > 5220 Emergency exits
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Emergency Exit doors used to facilitate evacuation that are not normally used for exit. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, locking units, handles, insulation, lining, controls, attach/attached fittings, etc.

entries.name: 5230 Cargo/Baggage doors
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 52 Doors > Maintenance Activity > 5230 Cargo/Baggage doors
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Exterior Cargo/Baggage doors used primarily to gain access to cargo compartments. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, motors, handles, insulation, lining, controls, integral steps, ramps, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.

entries.name: 5240 Service doors
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 52 Doors > Maintenance Activity > 5240 Service doors
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Exterior Service Doors used primarily to gain access for servicing aircraft systems and equipment and miscellaneous exterior doors used to fulfill system functions. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, insulation, lining, controls, integral steps, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.

entries.name: 5250 fixed inner doors
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 52 Doors > Maintenance Activity > 5250 fixed inner doors
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Fixed Inner Doors inside the fuselage installed in fixed partitions. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, lining, attach/attached fittings, etc. Does not include doors installed in movable partitions.

entries.name: 5260 Entrance stairs
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 52 Doors > Maintenance Activity > 5260 Entrance stairs
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Entrance Stairs which operate in conjunction with but are not an integral part of entrance doors. Stairs whose primary structure is a door shall be covered under the appropriate topic. Includes items such as structure, actuating mechanisms and controls, handrails, attach/attached fittings, etc.

entries.name: 5270 Door warning system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 52 Doors > Maintenance Activity > 5270 Door warning system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the door warning system which is used for the powered operation of the doors and/or to indicate whether the doors are closed and properly latched. Includes items such as motors, computers, sensors, switches, lights, bells, horns, etc. Does not include landing gear door warning.

entries.name: 5280 Landing gear doors
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 52 Doors > Maintenance Activity > 5280 Landing gear doors
entries.definition: Safety report related to the landing gear doors used to enclose the landing gear compartments. Includes items such as structure, latching mechanisms, handles, insulation, lining, controls, attach/attached fittings, etc.

entries.definition: Safety report related to the elevator control system which controls the position and movement of the elevator/elevon and tabs. entries.name: 2740 Stabilizer control system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 27 Flight Controls > Maintenance Activity > 2740 Stabilizer control system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the stabilizer control system which controls the position and movement of the horizontal stabilizer/canard. Includes items such as control handle, cables, jackscrews, motors, warning systems, linkages, control surfaces, position indicators, etc.

entries.name: 3000 Ice/Rain protection system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 30 Ice & Rain Protection > Maintenance Activity > 3000 Ice/Rain protection system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Tice/rain protection system which provide a means of preventing or disposing of formation of ice and rain on various parts of the aircraft. Includes alcohol pump, valves, tanks, propeller/rotor anti-icing system, wing heaters, water line heaters, pitot heaters, scoop heaters, windshield wipers and the electrical and heated air portion of windshield ice control. Does not include the basic windshield panel. For turbine type power plants using air as the anti-icing medium, engine anti-icing is contained under Air System.

entries.name: 3010 Airfoil anti/de-ice system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 30 Ice & Rain Protection > Maintenance Activity > 3010 Airfoil anti/de-ice system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the airfoil anti/de-ice system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on all airfoil surfaces. Includes wings, airfoil sections of the empennage, and pylons.

entries.name: 3020 Air intake anti/de-ice system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 30 Ice & Rain Protection > Maintenance Activity > 3020 Air intake anti/de-ice system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the air intake/de-ice system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice in or around air intakes. Includes power plant cowling anti-icing.

entries.name: 3030 Pitot/Static anti-ice system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 30 Ice & Rain Protection > Maintenance Activity > 3030 Pitot/Static anti-ice system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the pitot/static anti-ice system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on the pitot and static systems.

entries.name: 3040 Windshield/door rain/ice removal
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 30 Ice & Rain Protection > Maintenance Activity > 3040 Windshield/door rain/ice removal
entries.definition: Safety report related to the windshield/door rain/ice removal system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice, frost or rain on the Windows, windshields and doors.

entries.name: 3050 Antenna/Radome anti-ice/de-ice system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 30 Ice & Rain Protection > Maintenance Activity > 3050 Antenna/Radome anti-ice/de-ice system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the antenna/radome anti-ice/de-ice system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on antennas and radomes.

entries.name: 3060 Prop/Rotor anti-ice/de-ice system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 30 Ice & Rain Protection > Maintenance Activity > 3060 Prop/Rotor anti-ice/de-ice system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the prop/rotor anti-ice/de-ice system which is used to eliminate or prevent the formation of ice on propellers or rotors. Includes all components up to but not including rotating assembly.

entries.name: 3070 Water line anti-ice system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 30 Ice & Rain Protection > Maintenance Activity > 3070 Water line anti-ice system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the water line anti-ice system which is used to prevent the formation of ice in water supply and drain lines.

entries.name: 3080 Ice detection
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 30 Ice & Rain Protection > Maintenance Activity > 3080 Ice detection
entries.definition: Safety report related to the ice detection system which is used to detect and indicate the formation of ice.

entries.name: 3097 Ice/Rain protection system wiring

entries.name: 3100 Indicating/Recording system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 31 Instruments > Maintenance Activity > 3100 Indicating/Recording system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Pictorial coverage of all instruments, instrument panels and controls. Procedural coverage of those systems which give visual or aural warning of conditions in unrelated systems. Units which record, store or compute data from unrelated systems. Includes systems/units which integrate indicating instruments into a central display system and instruments not related to any specific system.

entries.name: 3110 Instrument panel
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 31 Instruments > Maintenance Activity > 3110 Instrument panel
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Coverage of all panels fixed or movable with their replaceable components such as instruments, switches, circuit breakers, fuses, etc. Also includes general coverage of instrument panel vibrators and other panel accessories.

entries.name: 3120 Independent instruments (clock, etc.)
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 31 Instruments > Maintenance Activity > 3120 Independent instruments (clock, etc.)
entries.definition: Safety report related to the instruments, units and components which are not related to specific systems. Includes items such as inclinometers, clocks, etc.

entries.name: 3130 Data recorders (FLT/maint)
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 31 Instruments > Maintenance Activity > 3130 Data recorders (FLT/maint)
entries.definition: Safety report related to the systems and components used for recording data not related to specific systems. Includes items such as flight recorders, performance or maintenance recorders, VG recorders, etc.

entries.name: 3140 Central computers (EICAS)
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 31 Instruments > Maintenance Activity > 3140 Central computers (EICAS)
entries.definition: Safety report related to the systems and components used for computing data from a number of different sources without a preponderance of functions in any one system. Includes items such as Digital Core Avionic System (DCAS), stored check list, emergency procedures, company regulations, etc., for call up on a display, integrated instrument systems such as engine, airplane power and central warning indicators when combined into a central display.

entries.name: 3150 Central warning
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 31 Instruments > Maintenance Activity > 3150 Central warning
entries.definition: Safety report related to the central warning systems and components which give audible or visual warning of conditions in unrelated systems. Includes items such as master warning or flight warning systems, central instrument warning, or caution and warning systems, tone generators, annunciators, etc.

entries.name: 3160 Central display

entries.definition: Safety report related to the central display systems and components which give visual display of conditions in unrelated systems.

entries.name: 3170 Automatic data
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 31 Instruments > Maintenance Activity > 3170 Automatic data
entries.definition: Safety report related to the  systems and components used for collating and computing data from unrelated systems and transmitting same automatically. Includes ASDAR systems and components.

entries.name: 3200 Landing gear system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 32 Landing Gear > Maintenance Activity > 3200 Landing gear system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the landing gear sytem units and components which furnish a means of supporting and steering the aircraft on the Groundor water, and make it possible to retract and store the landing gear in flight. Includes tail skid assembly, brakes, wheels, floats, skids, skis, doors, shock struts, tires, linkages, position indicating and warning systems. Also includes the functioning and maintenance aspects of the landing gear doors but does not include the structure.

entries.name: 3210 Main landing gear
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 32 Landing Gear > Maintenance Activity > 3210 Main landing gear
entries.definition: Safety report related to the main landing gear system which provides the major support for the aircraft while on the ground. Includes items such as shock struts, bogie axles, drag struts, doors, linkages, attach bolts, etc.

entries.name: 3220 Nose/Tail landing gear
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 32 Landing Gear > Maintenance Activity > 3220 Nose/Tail landing gear
entries.definition: Safety report related to the nose/tail landing gear system which supports the nose of the aircraft while the aircraft is on the ground. Includes items such as shock struts, drag struts, doors, linkages, attach bolts, etc.

entries.name: 3230 Landing gear retract/extend system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 32 Landing Gear > Maintenance Activity > 3230 Landing gear retract/extend system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the landing gear retract/extend system which is used to extend and retract the landing gear and open and close the landing gear doors. Includes items such as actuating mechanisms, bogie trim, bungees, up and down latches, operating controls, valves and motors, cables, wiring, plumbing, etc.

entries.name: 3240 Landing gear brake system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 32 Landing Gear > Maintenance Activity > 3240 Landing gear brake system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the landing gear brake system which provides for rolling and stopping the aircraft while on the Ground and stopping wheel rotation after retraction. Includes items such as bearings, tires, valves, de-boosters, swivel glands, anti-skid devices, pressure indicators, plumbing, etc.

entries.name: 3250 Landing gear steering system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 32 Landing Gear > Maintenance Activity > 3250 Landing gear steering system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the landing gear steering system which is used to control the direction of movement of the aircraft on the ground. Includes items such as actuating cylinders, controls, bogie swivel unlock, etc.

entries.name: 3260 Landing gear position and warning
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 32 Landing Gear > Maintenance Activity > 3260 Landing gear position and warning
entries.definition: Safety report related to the landing gear position and warning system which is used to indicate and warn of the position of the landing gear/doors. Includes items such as switches, relays, lights, indicators, horns, wiring, etc.

entries.name: 3270 Auxiliary gear (tail skid)
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 32 Landing Gear > Maintenance Activity > 3270 Auxiliary gear (tail skid)
entries.definition: Safety report related to the devices used to stabilize the aircraft while on the Ground and prevent damage by Ground contact. Includes items such as shock strut, skid block, wheels, etc.

entries.definition: A defect with the nosewheel steering which results in a reduction of manoeuvrability while on the ground

entries.definition: A flight deck indication that a brake overheat condition exists

entries.name: Tyres/Wheels

entries.definition: A failure of a tyre or wheel

entries.name: Gear - Vibration/Shimmy

entries.definition: Significant landing gear vibration or nosewheel shimmy is experienced

entries.name: 3320 Passenger compartment lighting
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 33 Lights > Maintenance Activity > 3320 Passenger compartment lighting
entries.definition: Safety report related to the lighting sub-systems in the areas in which the passengers are seated and in buffet/galley, lavatories, lounges and coat rooms. Includes items such as direct and indirect illumination, passenger call system, lighted signs, etc.

entries.name: 3330 Cargo compartment lighting
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 33 Lights > Maintenance Activity > 3330 Cargo compartment lighting
entries.definition: Safety report related to the lighting sub-systems in the compartments for stowage of cargo and the housing of various components of accessories

entries.name: 3340 Exterior lighting
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 33 Lights > Maintenance Activity > 3340 Exterior lighting
entries.definition: Safety report related to the lighting sub-systems used to provide illumination outside of the aircraft. Includes lights such as landing, navigation, position indicating, wing illumination, rotating, courtesy, taxi, etc.

entries.name: 3350 emergency lighting
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 33 Lights > Maintenance Activity > 3350 emergency lighting
entries.definition: Safety report related to the separate and independent subsystem used to provide illumination in case of primary electrical power failure. Includes items such as inertia flashlights, lanterns, etc.

entries.name: 3400 Navigation system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 34 Navigation > Maintenance Activity > 3400 Navigation system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the navigation system units and components which provide aircraft navigational information. Includes VOR, pitot, static, ILS, flight director, compasses, indicators, etc.

entries.name: 3410 Flight environment data
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 34 Navigation > Maintenance Activity > 3410 Flight environment data
entries.definition: Safety report related to the flight environment data system which senses environmental conditions and uses the data to influence navigation. Includes such items as Central Air Data Computers, pitot/static systems, air temperature, rate-of-climb, airspeed, high speed warning, altitude, altitude reporting, altimeter correction system, air disturbance detection system, etc.

entries.name: 3420 Attitude and direction data system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 34 Navigation > Maintenance Activity > 3420 Attitude and direction data system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the attitude and direction data system which uses magnetic or inertia forces to sense and display the direction or attitude of the aircraft. entries.name: 3430 Landing and taxi aids
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 34 Navigation > Maintenance Activity > 3430 Landing and taxi aids
entries.definition: Safety report related to the landing and taxi aids system which provides guidance during approach, landing and taxiing. Includes items such as localizer, glide slope, ILS, markers, paravisual director Ground guidance systems, etc.

entries.name: 3440 Independent pos. determining system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 34 Navigation > Maintenance Activity > 3440 Independent pos. determining system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the independent pos. determining system which provides information to determine position and is mainly independent of Ground installations or orbital satellites. entries.name: 3450 Dependent position determining
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 34 Navigation > Maintenance Activity > 3450 Dependent position determining
entries.definition: Safety report related to the dependent position determining system which provides information to determine position and is mainly dependent on Ground installations or orbital satellites. entries.name: 3460 Flight manage. computing hardware

entries.definition: Safety report related to the flight mamage. computing hardware system which combines navigational data to compute or manage the aircraft s geographical position or theoretical flight path. entries.definition: Safety report related to the turbine engine compressor section of the engine in which the air is compressed. Includes items such as cases, vanes, shrouds, rotors, diffusers, etc. Also includes the maintenance and overhaul of stator blades but not the operation of variable stator blades which is covered under [Chapter (System) 75 - 30]. Does not include compressor bleed system.

entries.name: 7240 Turbine engine combustion section
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 72 Turbine/Turboprop Engine > Maintenance Activity > 7240 Turbine engine combustion section
entries.definition: Safety report related to the turbine engine combustion section of the engine in which the air and fuel are combined and burned. Includes items such as burner cans, cases, etc.

entries.name: 7250 Turbine section
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 72 Turbine/Turboprop Engine > Maintenance Activity > 7250 Turbine section
entries.definition: Safety report related to the turbine engine section of the engine containing the turbines. Includes items such as turbine nozzles, turbine rotors, cases, etc.

entries.name: 7260 Turbine engine accessory drive
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 72 Turbine/Turboprop Engine > Maintenance Activity > 7260 Turbine engine accessory drive
entries.definition: Safety report related to the mechanical power take-offs to drive accessories. Includes items such as engine-mounted gear boxes, gears, seals, pumps, etc. Does not include remotely installed gear boxes.

entries.name: 7270 Turbine engine bypass section
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 72 Turbine/Turboprop Engine > Maintenance Activity > 7270 Turbine engine bypass section
entries.definition: Safety report related to the section of the engine which bypasses a portion of the normal engine airflow (either ram or compressed air) for the prime purpose of adding to engine thrust or reducing specific fuel consumption.

entries.name: ATA 73 Engine Fuel and Control
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 73 Engine Fuel and Control

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 73 Engine Fuel and Control > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 7300 Engine fuel and control
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 73 Engine Fuel and Control > Maintenance Activity > 7300 Engine fuel and control
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine and fuel control for turbine engines, those units and components and associated mechanical systems or electrical circuits which furnish or control fuel to the engine beyond the main fuel quick disconnect; and thrust augmenter, fuel flow rate sensing, transmitting and/or indicating units whether the units are before or beyond the quick disconnect.

entries.name: 7310 Engine fuel distribution
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 73 Engine Fuel and Control > Maintenance Activity > 7310 Engine fuel distribution
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine fuel distribution portion of the system from the main quick disconnect to the engine, which distributes fuel to the engine burner section and the thrust augmenter. Includes items such as plumbing, pumps, temperature regulators, valves, filters, manifold, nozzles, etc. Does not include the main or thrust augmenter fuel control.

entries.name: 7320 Fuel controlling system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 73 Engine Fuel and Control > Maintenance Activity > 7320 Fuel controlling system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the main fuel controlling system which meters fuel to the engine and to the thrust augmenter. Includes items such as hydromechanical or electronic fuel control, levers, actuators, cables, pulleys, linkages, sensors, valves, etc., which are components of the fuel control units.

entries.name: 7330 Engine fuel indicating system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 73 Engine Fuel and Control > Maintenance Activity > 7330 Engine fuel indicating system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine fuel indicating system which is used to indicate the flow rate, temperature and pressure of the fuel. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, etc. Does not include indication.

entries.name: ATA 74 Ignition
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 74 Ignition

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 74 Ignition > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 7400 Ignition system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 74 Ignition > Maintenance Activity > 7400 Ignition system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the ignition system units and components which generate, control, furnish, or distribute an electrical current to ignite the fuel air mixture in the cylinders of reciprocating engines or in the combustion chambers or thrust augmenters of turbine engines. Includes induction vibrators, magnetos, switches, lead filters, distributors, harnesses, plugs, ignition relays, exciters, and the electrical portion of spark advance.

entries.name: 7410 Ignition power supply
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 74 Ignition > Maintenance Activity > 7410 Ignition power supply
entries.definition: Safety report related to the ignition power supply portion of the system which generates electrical current for the purpose of igniting the fuel mixture in the combustion chambers and thrust augmenters. Includes items such as magnetos, distributors, booster coils, exciters, transformers, storage capacitors and compositors, etc.

entries.name: 7420 Ignition harness (distribution)
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 74 Ignition > Maintenance Activity > 7420 Ignition harness (distribution)
entries.definition: Safety report related to the ignition harness (distribution) portion of the system which conducts high or low voltage electricity from the electrical power supply to the spark plugs, or igniters. Includes wiring between magneto and distributor in those systems where they are separate units. Includes items such as ignition harness, high tension leads, coils as used in "low tension" systems, spark plugs, igniters, etc.

entries.name: 7430 Ignition/Starter switching
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 74 Ignition > Maintenance Activity > 7430 Ignition/Starter switching
entries.definition: Safety report related to the ignition/starter switching portion of the system which provides a means of rendering the electrical power supply inoperative. Includes items such as ignition switches, wiring, connectors, etc.

entries.name: ATA 75 Air
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 75 Air

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 75 Air > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 7500 Engine bleed air system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 75 Air > Maintenance Activity > 7500 Engine bleed air system
entries.definition: For turbine engines, those external units and components and integral basic engine parts which go together to conduct air to various portions of the engine and to the extension shaft and torquemeter, assembly, if any.Includes compressor bleed systems  used to control flow of air through the  engine, cooling air systems and heated air systems for engine anti-icing. Does not include aircraft anti-icing, engine starting systems, nor exhaust supplementary air systems.

entries.name: 7510 Engine anti-icing system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 75 Air > Maintenance Activity > 7510 Engine anti-icing system
entries.definition: That portion of the system which is used to eliminate and prevent the formation of ice by bleed air in all parts of the engine, excluding power plant cowling which is covered under [Chapter (System) 30]. Includes items such as valves, plumbing, wiring,  regulators, etc.

entries.name: 7520 Engine cooling system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 75 Air > Maintenance Activity > 7520 Engine cooling system
entries.definition: That portion of the system which is used to ventilate the engine and accessories. Includes items such as valves, plumbing, wiring, jet pumps, vortex spoilers, etc.

entries.name: 7530 Compressor bleed control
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 75 Air > Maintenance Activity > 7530 Compressor bleed control
entries.definition: That portion of the system which is used to control the flow of air through the engine. Includes items such as governors, valves, actuators, linkages, etc. Also includes the operation of variable stator blades, but not the maintenance and overhaul.

entries.name: 7540 Bleed air indicating system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 75 Air > Maintenance Activity > 7540 Bleed air indicating system
entries.definition: That portion of the system which is used to indicate temperature, pressure, control positions, etc., of the air systems. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, etc.

entries.name: ATA 76 Engine Controls
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 76 Engine Controls

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 76 Engine Controls > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 7600 Engine controls
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 76 Engine Controls > Maintenance Activity > 7600 Engine controls
entries.definition: Safety report related to those controls which govern operation of the engine. Includes units and components which are interconnected for emergency shutdown. For turbo-prop engines, includes linkages and controls to the coordinator or equivalent to the propeller governor, fuel control unit or other units being controlled. For reciprocating engines, includes controls for blowers. Does not include units or components which are specifically included in other chapters.

entries.name: 7601 Engine synchronizing
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 76 Engine Controls > Maintenance Activity > 7601 Engine synchronizing
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine synchronizing controls which govern operation of the engine.

entries.name: 7602 Mixture control
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 76 Engine Controls > Maintenance Activity > 7602 Mixture control
entries.definition: Safety report related to the mixture controls which govern operation of the engine.

entries.name: 7603 Power lever
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 76 Engine Controls > Maintenance Activity > 7603 Power lever
entries.definition: Safety report related to thepower lever controls which govern operation of the engine.

entries.name: 7620 Engine emergency shutdown system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 76 Engine Controls > Maintenance Activity > 7620 Engine emergency shutdown system
entries.definition: Safety report related to that portion of the system which furnishes a means of controlling the flow of fluids to and from the engine during emergency procedures. Includes items such as levers, cables, pulleys, linkages, switches, wiring, etc. Does not include the units themselves.

entries.name: 7700 Engine Indicating System
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > 7700 Engine Indicating System

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > 7700 Engine Indicating System > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 7700 Engine indicating system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > 7700 Engine Indicating System > Maintenance Activity > 7700 Engine indicating system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine indicating system, units, components and associated systems which indicate engine operation. Includes indicators, transmitters, analyzers, etc. For turboprop engines includes phase detectors. Does not include systems or items which are specifically included in other chapters except when indication is accomplished as part of an integrated engine instrument system

entries.name: 7710 Power indicating system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > 7700 Engine Indicating System > Maintenance Activity > 7710 Power indicating system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the power indicating system which directly or indirectly indicates power or thrust. Includes items such as BMEP, pressure-ratio, RPM, etc.

entries.name: 7720 Engine temp. indicating system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > 7700 Engine Indicating System > Maintenance Activity > 7720 Engine temp. indicating system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine temp.indicating system which indicates temperatures in the engine. Includes items such as cylinder head, exhaust (turbine inlet), etc.

entries.name: 7730 Engine ignition analyzer system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > 7700 Engine Indicating System > Maintenance Activity > 7730 Engine ignition analyzer system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine ignition analyzer system which is used to analyze engine performance or condition by means of instruments or devices such as oscilloscopes, etc. Includes items such as generators, wiring, amplifiers, oscilloscopes, etc.

entries.name: 7740 Engine integrated instrument system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > 7700 Engine Indicating System > Maintenance Activity > 7740 Engine integrated instrument system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the portion of the system which is an integrated concept receives several/all engine operating parameters and transmits this to a central processor for crew presentation. Includes items such as display units, transmitters, receivers, computers, etc.

entries.name: ATA 78 Engine Exhaust
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 78 Engine Exhaust

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 78 Engine Exhaust > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 7800 Engine exhaust system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 78 Engine Exhaust > Maintenance Activity > 7800 Engine exhaust system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine exhaust system units and components which direct the engine exhaust gases overboard. For turbine engines, includes units external to the basic engine such as thrust reverser and noise suppressor. For reciprocating engines, includes augmenters, stacks, clamps, etc. excludes exhaust-driven turbines.

entries.name: 7810 Engine collector/tailpipe/nozzle
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 78 Engine Exhaust > Maintenance Activity > 7810 Engine collector/tailpipe/nozzle
entries.definition: Safety report related to that portion of the system which collects the exhaust gases from the cylinders or turbines and conducts them overboard. Includes items such as collector rings, exhaust and thrust augmenter ducts, variable nozzles, actuators, plumbing, linkages, wiring, position indicators, warning systems, etc. Does not include power recovery turbines, turbo-superchargers, etc., not noise suppressors or thrust reversers where they are not an integral part of the nozzle system.

entries.name: 7820 Engine noise suppressor
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 78 Engine Exhaust > Maintenance Activity > 7820 Engine noise suppressor
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine noise supressor portion of the system which reduces the noise generated by the exhaust gases. Includes items such as pipes, baffles, shields, actuators, plumbing linkages, wiring, position indicators, warning systems, etc. Use - 10 where integral part of nozzle system.

entries.name: 7830 Thrust reverser
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 78 Engine Exhaust > Maintenance Activity > 7830 Thrust reverser
entries.definition: Safety report related to the thrust reverser portion of the system which is used to change the direction of the exhaust gases for reverse thrust. Includes items such as clamshells, linkages, levers, actuators, plumbing, wiring, indicators, warning systems, etc. Use -10 where integral part of nozzle system.

entries.name: ATA 79 Engine Oil
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 79 Engine Oil

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 79 Engine Oil > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 7900 Engine oil system (airframe)
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 79 Engine Oil > Maintenance Activity > 7900 Engine oil system (airframe)
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine oil system (airframe) units and components external to the engine concerned with storing and delivering lubricating oil to and from the engine. Covers all units and components from the lubricating oil engine outlet to the inlet, including the inlet and outlet fittings, tank, radiator,by-pass valve, etc., and auxiliary oil systems.

entries.name: 7910 Engine oil storage (airframe)
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 79 Engine Oil > Maintenance Activity > 7910 Engine oil storage (airframe)
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine oil storage (airframe) portion of the system used for storage of oil. Includes items such as tanks, filling systems, internal hoppers, baffles, tank sump and drain, etc. Does not include tanks which are an integral portion of the engine.

entries.name: 7920 Engine oil distribution (airframe)
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 79 Engine Oil > Maintenance Activity > 7920 Engine oil distribution (airframe)
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine oil distribution (airframe) portion of the system which is used to conduct oil from and to the engine. Includes items such as plumbing, valves, temperature regulator, control systems, etc.

entries.name: 7930 Engine oil indicating system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 79 Engine Oil > Maintenance Activity > 7930 Engine oil indicating system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine oil indicating portion of the system which is used to indicate the quantity, temperature and pressure of the oil. Includes items such as transmitters, indicators, wiring, warning systems, etc. Does not include indication if indication is accomplished as part of an integrated engine instrument system

entries.name: ATA 80 Starting
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 80 Starting

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 80 Starting > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 8000 Engine starting system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 80 Starting > Maintenance Activity > 8000 Engine starting system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine starting system units, components and associated systems used for starting the engine. Includes electrical, inertia air or other starter systems. Does not include ignition systems.

entries.name: 8010 Engine cranking
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 80 Starting > Maintenance Activity > 8010 Engine cranking
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine cranking portion of the system which is used to perform the cranking portion of the starting operation. Includes items such as plumbing, valves, wiring, starters, switches, relays, etc.

entries.name: 8011 Engine starter
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 80 Starting > Maintenance Activity > 8011 Engine starter
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine starter system

entries.name: 8097 Engine starting system wiring
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 80 Starting > Maintenance Activity > 8097 Engine starting system wiring
entries.definition: Safety report related to the engine starting system wiring

entries.name: ATA 81 Turbocharging
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 81 Turbocharging

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 81 Turbocharging > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 8120 Exhaust turbocharger
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 81 Turbocharging > Maintenance Activity > 8120 Exhaust turbocharger
entries.definition: Safety report related to the turbines which extract energy from the exhaust gases and are coupled to the crankshaft.

entries.name: ATA 82 Water Injection
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 82 Water Injection

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 82 Water Injection > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 8200 Water injection system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 82 Water Injection > Maintenance Activity > 8200 Water injection system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the water injection system units and components which furnish, meter and inject water or water mixtures into the induction system, includes tanks, pumps, regulators, etc.

entries.name: ATA 83 Accessory Gearboxed
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 83 Accessory Gearboxed

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 83 Accessory Gearboxed > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 8300 Accessory gearboxes
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 83 Accessory Gearboxed > Maintenance Activity > 8300 Accessory gearboxes
entries.definition: Safety report related to the accessory gearboxes units and components which are remotely installed and connected to the engine by a drive shaft and hich drive multiple types of accessories. Does not include those accessory drives which are bolted to and are immediately adjacent to the engine.

entries.name: ATA 71 - 85 Engine
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine

entries.name: FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists

entries.name: High oil consumption
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > High oil consumption
entries.definition: The engine oil consumption is considered excessive

entries.name: Intake doors/ramps
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Intake doors/ramps
entries.definition: Includes incorrect positioning or sequencing of the intake doors or ramps

entries.name: Limit exceedence
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Limit exceedence
entries.definition: The engine has been operated outside of the published criteria

entries.name: Oil pressure
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Oil pressure
entries.definition: Can include either high, low or fluctuating oil pressure

entries.name: Oil quantity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Oil quantity
entries.definition: Oil quantity reduces below the minimum for normal engine operation or the oil level increases outside the normal operating range

entries.name: Oil leak
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Oil leak
entries.definition: Normally used for leaks found during the pre-departure inspection

entries.name: Placard incorrect
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Placard incorrect
entries.definition: Normally used for errors in placarding of engine ratings

entries.name: Surge/Stall
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Surge/Stall
entries.definition: Includes any surge or stall that automatically recovers

entries.name: Thrust reverser unlock/unstow
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Thrust reverser unlock/unstow
entries.definition: The thrust reverser fails to deploy or stow on selection. Or unlocks without selection

entries.name: Uncontained failure
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Uncontained failure
entries.definition: Debris from the failed engine causes damage to other aircraft parts

entries.name: Vibration
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Vibration
entries.definition: High engine vibration is indicated or felt

entries.name: Throttle stagger
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Throttle stagger
entries.definition: Through all stages of engine operation

entries.name: Thrust lever/throttle jam/stiff
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Thrust lever/throttle jam/stiff
entries.definition: Through all stages of engine operation

entries.name: Fluctuating power
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Fluctuating power
entries.definition: The engine has failed to achieve the calculated take-off power for the current ambient conditions

entries.name: Indication
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Indication
entries.definition: A significant engine indication failure or false engine warning  (not fire warning)

entries.name: Hot start
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Hot start
entries.definition: An event where an engine start has been aborted due to rapidly rising EGT/TGT

entries.name: Low thrust/power
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Low thrust/power
entries.definition: Normally used during the take-off phase but can be used through all stages of engine operation

entries.name: Damage
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Damage
entries.definition: Would normally be identified during the pre-departure check

entries.name: Asymmetric power
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Asymmetric power
entries.definition: Through all stages of engine operation

entries.name: Fuel leak
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Fuel leak
entries.definition: Normally used for fuel leaks observed during the pre-departure inspection

entries.name: Start/Ignition
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Start/Ignition
entries.definition: Engine failed to complete starting sequence

entries.name: EEC/FADEC
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > EEC/FADEC
entries.definition: Failure of the Engine Electronic Control (or equivalent) system

entries.name: Uncommanded power  change
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Uncommanded power  change
entries.definition: Uncommanded variation in power from engine

entries.name: Oil contamination
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Oil contamination
entries.definition: Warning of engine oil contamination  e.g. filter by-pass, chip detector, or other contaminants entered oil system (fuel, etc)

entries.name: In-flight shutdown
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > In-flight shutdown
entries.definition: An in-flight engine shut down

entries.name: Ground shutdown
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Ground shutdown
entries.definition: A ground engine shut down

entries.name: Rundown
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Rundown
entries.definition: Uncommanded engine rundown due to technical defect(s)

entries.name: Engine overheat
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Engine overheat

entries.name: Failed to Shutdown
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 71 - 85 Engine > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Failed to Shutdown
entries.definition: An engine that fails to shutdown during a normal or emergency shutdown procedure

entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 38 Water/Waste

entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 38 Water/Waste > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 3800 Water and waste system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 38 Water/Waste > Maintenance Activity > 3800 Water and waste system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the water and waste system fixed units and components which store and deliver for use, fresh water, and those fixed components which store and furnish a means of removal of water and waste. Includes wash basins, toilet assemblies, tanks, valves, etc.

entries.name: 3810 Potable water system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 38 Water/Waste > Maintenance Activity > 3810 Potable water system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the potable water system which is used to store and deliver fresh drinking water. Includes wash water system if the potable water is also used for washing.

entries.name: 3820 Wash water system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 38 Water/Waste > Maintenance Activity > 3820 Wash water system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the wash water portion of the system which is used to store and deliver wash water which is not potable.

entries.name: 3830 Waste disposal system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 38 Water/Waste > Maintenance Activity > 3830 Waste disposal system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the water disposal portion of the system which is used for disposal of water and waste. Includes items such as wash basins, water closets, flushing systems, etc.

entries.name: 3840 Air supply (water press. system)
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 38 Water/Waste > Maintenance Activity > 3840 Air supply (water press. system)
entries.definition: Safety report related to the air supply portion of the system common to more than one sub-system which is used for pressurizing supply tanks to insure fluid flow.

entries.name: Evidence of blue ice

entries.name: Blue ice shed from aircraft

entries.name: Potable water contaminated

entries.name: Toilet/Lavatory fluid leak in cabin
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 38 Water/Waste > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Toilet/Lavatory fluid leak in cabin
entries.definition: Any fluid leaking from a toilet area

entries.name: Potable water leak
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 38 Water/Waste > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Potable water leak
entries.definition: A water leak whether internal or external from the aircrafts potable water supply

entries.name: Toilet/Lavatory full/inoperative
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 38 Water/Waste > FOPS Non-Normal/Checklists > Toilet/Lavatory full/inoperative
entries.definition: A toilet has been reported inoperative or is full rendering it unusable

entries.name: ATA 56 Windows
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 56 Windows

entries.name: Maintenance Activity
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 56 Windows > Maintenance Activity

entries.name: 5600 Window/Windshield system
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 56 Windows > Maintenance Activity > 5600 Window/Windshield system
entries.definition: Safety report related to the  Fuselage and crew compartment windows inclusive of windshield; also, those windows installed in doors

entries.name: 5610 Flight compartment windows
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 56 Windows > Maintenance Activity > 5610 Flight compartment windows
entries.definition: Safety report related to the flight compartment windows, i.e., Compartment above the floor and between the forward passenger partition and the forward pressure dome. Includes items such as the transparent material and its frame of sliding and fixed windows and windshields, handles, latching mechanisms, etc. Does not include door or inspection/observation windows.

entries.name: 5620 Passenger compartment windows
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 56 Windows > Maintenance Activity > 5620 Passenger compartment windows
entries.definition: Safety report related to the passenger compartment windows i.e., Area in which the passengers are seated. Includes lounges, lavatories, buffets/galleys and coatrooms. Includes items such as transparent material, its frame, frost shield, etc.

entries.name: 5630 Door windows
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 56 Windows > Maintenance Activity > 5630 Door windows
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Door windows used for entrance and exit of the passengers, flight crew and service personnel to and from the airplane. Includes items such as transparent material, its frame, etc. Does not include emergency exit windows.

entries.name: 5640 Inspection windows
entries.label: Engineering/Maintenance > ATA 56 Windows > Maintenance Activity > 5640 Inspection windows
entries.definition: Safety report related to the Windows used for examining compartments and equipment in and about the airplane, and astrodomes used for celestial navigation. Includes items such as transparent material, its frame, etc.
